exposure: receipt of financial aid from the Federal Government
serious complications during pregnancy and postpartum
cohort: 1042 mothers of children up to 1 year old
finding: SMM rate was positively associated with older maternal age, lower maternal educational level, inadequate prenatal care, and receipt of government financial aid, while it was inversely associated with Cesarean delivery and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a decreased risk of SMM (decrease of 49.0%).
